correctness.rationale: Every 1- or 2-spin block flip changes only its two boundary bond terms, giving exact wall admissibility at strict radius-one/radius-two coupling minima. Parity makes the stable count S_k=2^{M_k}. Five rational overlapping-window probabilities are evaluated as explicit integrals and independently enumerated by rank order; summing displacement covariances gives 2/45, -1/315, and 13/450 for n>=11. Bounded four-dependent indicator vectors satisfy the vector finite-dependent CLT. Executed package code checked 144 spin-level enumerations and the complete 9! bond-order covariance census. No finite test is used as proof of the CLT.

value.rationale: The physically natural hierarchy of one- and two-spin strict metastability has pointwise nested counts, but their log-count sample-to-sample fluctuations anticorrelate. An exact, finite-size, distribution-free negative covariance and full bivariate fluctuation law quantify a genuine source of disorder-induced trapping heterogeneity that single-level complexity exponents cannot address.
